registration: Traced by eye on the painting map/surface.png, 2026-11-17. Coast, marsh, river, wood edge, range and mere follow the paint; the Keeper should re-check each polygon against the painting at Night 3 and fix the data, never the paint.

regions.name: The Grey Sea
regions.notes: Cold grey water with a rocky headland at the valley's foot and shoals off the marsh.

regions.name: The Sea Marsh
regions.notes: Braided creeks between the headland and the Ald's mouth. The shingle bar where the god woke is here.

regions.name: The Ald Valley
regions.terrain: valley, water meadow and scattered oak
regions.notes: The Riverfolk's forty miles of the Ald, from the falls at the wood's edge to the marsh.

regions.name: The Drover's Hills
regions.notes: Rounded ochre hills with a dark mere in a fold, falling to open ground south where a drove path runs.

regions.name: The North Wood
regions.notes: Dark unbroken wood over the whole top left of the painting. The Ald comes out of it over the falls.

regions.name: The Greywall
regions.notes: The snow range across the top right. Its foothills shade into the hills.

features.name: River Ald
features.notes: Rises in the wood; the first falls are where it leaves the trees. Flows south to the marsh and the sea.

features.name: Black Mere
features.notes: The dark tarn in the fold of the hills, right of center.

features.name: Oxmouth
features.notes: On the last firm ground east of the mouth. The god's landing, the Riverfolk's largest village.

features.name: Wellbrook
features.notes: East bank, mid valley, where a brook comes down from the hills.

features.name: Aldford
features.notes: At the great bend, where the river can be forded in summer.

features.name: Fallstead
features.notes: Below the first falls, where the Ald leaves the wood. The last village the Riverfolk hold.

features.name: Greywall Pass
features.notes: The dip in the range between the two snow masses.

features.name: the King's Fort
features.notes: Old earthworks on the hill crest above the mere.

features.name: Salt Cave
features.notes: In the rocky headland at the marsh's north end.
